paragraphs.text: Marivel is a panther warrior from Urborg on Dominaria , and the leader of Free Urborg .

Marivel lost her parents to the brutality of the Cabal . When she discovered the lost city of Vhelnish , she learned from its ancient knowledge to become one of Urborg's most powerful necromancers and the leader of the Free Urborg resistance. She is currently the ruler of Vhelnish .
It is unknown what happened to Marivel after the death of Belzenlok .
